siteDiagnostic.network: Cannot connect to the site. Check your network, proxy and whether the site is available.
siteDiagnostic.loginRedirect: The site redirected to its login page. Your cookies have expired or are incomplete. Sign in to the site in your browser, then sync cookies again.
siteDiagnostic.parse: Unexpected site response. The site may have changed, or expired credentials may have returned a login page.
siteDiagnostic.challenge: Blocked by a Cloudflare challenge (status {code}). cf_clearance is tied to the browser’s User-Agent and public IP address. Syncing cookies alone usually cannot resolve this.
siteDiagnostic.forbidden: The site denied access (status {code}). Credentials may have expired. Verify or update them.
siteDiagnostic.rateLimited: The site rate limited requests (status {code}). Requests will slow down automatically.
siteDiagnostic.unavailable: The site server is temporarily unavailable (status {code}). This is usually a site issue. Wait for it to recover.
siteDiagnostic.http: The site returned an unexpected status: {code}. Try again later or check credentials.
